result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue: the promotional banner text has insufficient color contrast and is barely readable.

issues.description: The promotional banner '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' use white text on a very light mint background, making the text barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color on the light background or darken the banner background to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements
